description: This PHP source file defines the class FileUrlGenerator, which implements URL generation for files within the Drupal framework, including methods for creating absolute and relative URLs, handling different URI schemes, and integrating with Drupal's stream wrapper and request stack.

classes.name: FileUrlGenerator
classes.description: Implements URL generation for files, handling different URI schemes, and integrating with Drupal's stream wrapper and request stack.

methods.name: generateString
methods.description: Returns a URL string for a given URI, either relative or absolute.

methods.name: generateAbsoluteString
methods.description: Returns an absolute URL string for a given URI.

methods.name: doGenerateString
methods.description: Creates an external URL string based on the URI and whether it should be relative.

methods.name: generatePath
methods.description: Generates a URL path based on the base URL and URI, handling different URI formats.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Returns a Url object for a given URI, handling various schemes and wrappers.

methods.name: transformRelative
methods.description: Transforms a file URL into a relative URL based on the current request context.
